CapabilityInventory.Concept: Ordered Multi-Layer Marks (RECT, LINE, POINT, RULE, AREA, ARC)
CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Supported in ChartSpec & PlotPlan contracts; limited to named COMBO and OVERLAYS in Report-SQL syntax
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: Report-SQL parser cannot currently declare arbitrary multi-layer specs (e.g. LAYER RECT + LAYER LINE + LAYER POINT in a single visual body)

CapabilityInventory.Concept: Dual-Axis Bindings (Primary Y vs Secondary Y2)
CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Supported in contracts and exposed via COMBO (Y on Left, Y2 on Right)
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: Fully functional in ChartSpec, ECharts, and SVG renderers; terminal renderer provides placeholder/table fallback

CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Declared in ScaleResolutionSpec (Shared vs Independent); multi-facet splitting is not yet implemented in PlotPlanResolver
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: PlotPlanResolver currently resolves single-panel bounds and does not split datasets into sub-panel coordinate spaces

CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: FacetSpec model exists in contracts; multi-panel layout resolution pending Phase 7
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: Requires facet-aware canvas grid partitioning in SVG and ECharts lowerers

CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Fully supported across contracts, ECharts, and SVG renderers (BAR, HBAR, PIE, DONUT)
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: Complete across contracts and native SVG; terminal renderer maps Polar to proportional Spectre breakdown tables

CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Absent in contracts; all layers currently bind to the single root dataReference
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: MarkLayerSpec does not contain an optional DataReference override property

CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Absent in contracts; transformations must be pre-staged via SQL queries into #temp tables
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: FieldBinding only accepts simple column identifier strings, not scalar expression ASTs

CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Absent in contracts; mark styles are static StyleToken lists per layer
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: No contract model for condition-driven style rules (e.g. IF value < 0 THEN color='#EF4444')

CapabilityInventory.StatusSummary: Fully supported via SemanticFallback and AccessibleSummary generation in PlotPlanResolver
CapabilityInventory.TechnicalGapDetail: Production-ready: produces deterministic structured text tables and screen-reader narratives

SurfaceConformanceMatrix.ECharts Browser Runtime: Full support for Cartesian, Transposed, Polar, Multi-Layer, Dual-Axis, and Series Palette.
SurfaceConformanceMatrix.Native PlotPlan SVG: Full support for Native Vector Cartesian, Dual-Axis, Lines, Rects, Points, Rules, Arcs, Micro-Sparklines, and Micro-Progress without browser/V8 dependencies.
SurfaceConformanceMatrix.Spectre Terminal Output: Support for Braille Continuous Curves, Bar Panels, Slicers, and Semantic Plain-Text Breakdown Tables.
SurfaceConformanceMatrix.Accessible Screen-Reader Fallbacks: Deterministic SemanticFallbackItem tables, Summary narratives, and GFM tables.

ArchitecturalReadinessSummary: ChartSpec and PlotPlan provide a robust semantic foundation capable of multi-layer composition, dual-scale coordinates, and rich accessibility.
Primary semantic gaps for Phase 7 are at the authoring/syntax layer (Report-SQL grammar for layer definitions) and client-side reactive facet splitting.
Existing rendering pipelines (ECharts and Native SVG) cleanly decouple from Report-SQL syntax and can consume future advanced authoring specs without architectural redesign.
